schema: FlatSchema with FIX.4.4 raw loopback peer; D/8 and tags 11, 17, 35, 55, 58, 900001, 900002

queued-ring/callback.completion_boundary: scheduled FIX D generation time to final FIX 8 reply observation by the Python peer

round_trip_ns.scope: scheduled time to the case completion boundary

actual_origin_round_trip_ns.scope: actual generation/API-origin time to the same completion boundary

generation_lateness_ns.scope: actual FIX generation/origin timestamp minus scheduled timestamp; all planned samples retained

queued-ring/callback.callback_ingress_delay_note: Python peer FIX D send start to Engine callback start; includes socket, parse, owner and queued dispatch time, not an isolated worker-queue wait; do not compare directly with sender-source cases
queued-ring/callback.server_boundary: scheduled Python FIX D generation time to callback-generated FIX 8 receive
queued-ring/callback.receipt_semantics: SessionContext::send returns the Driver receipt state available at API return (accepted/appended/written depending on callback policy); peer receive is separately observed and establishes delivery

diagnostic_perf_counters.scope: user-space phase-wide PMU diagnostics; existing threads plus inherited producers; includes harness; multiplex-scaled per-thread sums

kernel_send_diagnostic.bounds_note: accepted_return_ns is sampled immediately after the API call; scheduling can intervene before that sample. API acceptance occurs inside the call, bracketed by api_start_ns and accepted_return_ns. kernel_write_return_ns is sampled after send returned all bytes of the frame to the kernel, not peer receipt. Lower bound is max(0, write_return - accepted_return); upper bound is write_return - api_start. Raw signed deltas are preserved; a negative raw delta counts a write before the post-call observation, and does not prove it preceded the actual API return. Impossible negative upper bounds fail validation.
kernel_send_diagnostic.scope: separate diagnostic pass with send wrapper enabled; includes only complete tracked FIX D/8 frames from the measured phase

diagnostic_scope: separate child process/pass; atomic wrappers for executable/static objects; calls originating wholly inside shared libraries may bypass hooks; counters cover the measured phase including harness coordination, producer wake/poll and receipt polling. The executable is linked with a send wrapper in both passes; tracking is disabled in the timed pass, which still pays wrapper dispatch and atomic flag-read overhead, while only the diagnostic pass parses frame bytes
allocation_counter_semantics: successful malloc/calloc/realloc and overridden C++ new requests; bytes sum requested sizes, realloc counts the full new size rather than its delta
timing_scope: real Engine, mmap Journal, FIX codec and localhost TCP; no fsync/fdatasync/msync durability guarantee
counter_normalization: diagnostic totals divided by measured sample count are phase-wide per-sample normalized costs, not steady-state per-message hot-path costs
writeback_observation_scope: read-only host-wide counters and dirty_* tunables; deltas include concurrent machine activity and cannot be attributed to this process

host_writeback_observation.scope: host-wide; deltas are concurrent machine activity and cannot be attributed to this process
